About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About Figure

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.

Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our growing team! As Senior Data Scientist, you’ll develop and apply modern machine learning and artificial intelligence across a range of products and business problems. You’ll combine strong computer science foundations, rigorous experimental judgment, and the ability to turn advances in AI into reliable systems with measurable business impact. The work spans document intelligence, multimodal systems that combine text, images, and structured data, and the adaptation of foundation models using proprietary datasets. These models support complex workflows in regulated financial services, where accuracy, explainability, data governance, reproducibility, and careful evaluation are essential. You’ll work across the full machine learning lifecycle and turn successful approaches into reusable AI capabilities, patterns, and components that support multiple teams rather than building a one-off solution for every problem.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify high-impact opportunities for machine learning and AI in partnership with product, engineering, operations, and business teams
  • Design, train, fine-tune, and evaluate machine learning and deep-learning models
  • Work with foundation models across language, vision, and multimodal applications
  • Develop robust datasets, features, training pipelines, and evaluation frameworks
  • Run efficient experiments on GPU infrastructure and improve model quality, speed, and cost
  • Compare alternative modeling approaches and make clear recommendations based on empirical results and business impact
  • Build reusable modeling components, evaluation frameworks, and implementation patterns that accelerate work across teams and projects
  • Establish clear interfaces and standards that allow other teams to adopt proven AI capabilities without rebuilding the underlying modeling work
  • Build models and supporting systems that are reproducible, testable, and suitable for production use
  • Partner with ML and software engineers on deployment, monitoring, reliability, and ongoing model improvement
  • Communicate results, limitations, and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Stay current with advances in machine learning and determine when emerging techniques are mature enough to create practical value
  • Turn ambiguous business needs into well-defined machine learning problems and measurable success criteria
  • Build models that improve real customer or operational outcomes, not only offline metrics
  • Make thoughtful tradeoffs among model quality, complexity, latency, reliability, and cost
  • Create reusable foundations that allow multiple teams to apply proven AI capabilities to new problems more quickly and consistently
  • Help raise the organization’s technical standards for experimentation, evaluation, and production AI

What We Look For

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of experience developing machine learning solutions, including experience taking models beyond initial experimentation
  • Strong programming and software-engineering skills, particularly in Python
  • Strong foundations in machine learning, statistics, algorithms, data structures, and experimental design
  • Hands-on experience with deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
  • Experience training or fine-tuning transformer-based, vision, or multimodal models
  • Experience working with GPUs and understanding the practical constraints of model training and inference
  • Ability to work with large, complex, and imperfect datasets
  • Demonstrated ability to own open-ended problems from initial investigation through implementation and measurement
  • Demonstrated ability to generalize successful solutions into reusable capabilities rather than one-off models
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field (preferred)
  • Experience with distributed training, model optimization, quantization, or parameter-efficient fine-tuning (preferred)
  • Experience deploying and monitoring machine learning models in production (preferred)
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, distributed data processing, and modern ML development platforms (preferred)
  • Experience building AI systems in regulated, risk-sensitive, or high-stakes environments (preferred)
  • Contributions to applied research, open-source projects, patents, or production AI products (preferred)
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

  • Base Compensation Range: $132,000 - $198,000/yr
  • 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly

While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Transaction Risk team builds the machine learning systems behind Stripe Radar, helping businesses prevent fraud and abuse while letting legitimate customers through. We combine intelligence from across Stripe’s global network with real-time models and AI agents to protect businesses across the customer lifecycle, from signup and free trials to payments and ongoing usage, with a growing focus on the emerging threats facing AI companies.

The team is growing, and expanding into multiple new areas. We are building abuse protections across the full customer life-cycle and solving emerging token fraud problems to make Stripe the default fraud and abuse solution for AI.

What you’ll do

You will own major ML systems and initiatives from problem definition to production. You'll find where ML can make the biggest difference, design the approach, build and ship models and the systems around them, and keep improving them as data, users, and attackers change.

Your work may include protecting businesses from abuse across the customer lifecycle, building adaptive and customizable fraud systems for Stripe's largest users, or extending risk intelligence to 50+ global payment methods. Across all of these, you'll use modern approaches, such as transformer models over payment data, graph intelligence across consumers, and LLMs that detect emerging attacks. 

You will have opportunities to ship 0→1 products, and to improve mission-critical ML models operating at Stripe scale, often driving several efforts in parallel and setting the technical bar for the team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and delivery of ML projects end to end, from framing the problem and sizing the opportunity through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Build, train, evaluate, and deploy models that detect fraud and abuse across Stripe’s global network, and own the production systems they run on.
  • Investigate emerging fraud and abuse patterns, decide where ML can have the most impact, and quickly turn those insights into shipped protections.
  • Design features, datasets, and evaluation strategies for noisy, delayed, and adversarial environments, and set the bar for experimental rigor.
  • Make sound architecture and modeling tradeoffs between model quality, legitimate-user impact, latency, reliability, and operational cost.
  • Be the go-to expert for the systems you own: lead incident response for model regressions, reduce operational toil, and make your systems easy for others to build on.
  • Partner with engineering, product, data science, risk experts, and leading Stripe users to turn modeling improvements into differentiated Radar products.
  • Turn recurring problems into reusable components, tools, and AI-assisted workflows that speed up the whole team.
  • Mentor engineers, give thoughtful design and code reviews, and help new teammates ramp up quickly.

Who you are

You are an experienced ML engineer who combines deep modeling expertise with strong engineering judgment. You've owned ML systems in production, shipped multiple meaningful improvements, and made the people around you more effective. You move fast without breaking things, you're comfortable leading through ambiguity, and you're excited to work at the frontier of payments and AI, turning advances in machine learning into production systems that address new forms of fraud and abuse.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience developing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.
  • A track record of leading ML projects from problem definition to production, with measurable impact.
  • Deep foundations in machine learning, statistics, model evaluation, and experiment design.
  • Strong programming and software-engineering skills, with experience writing tested, maintainable code for production ML applications.
  • Experience designing and operating production ML systems, including several of: large-scale data and feature pipelines, distributed model training, low-latency inference, model deployment, or production monitoring.

We’re bringing together exceptional creative talent to tell the stories of people shaping the future. Work alongside people who raise your standards, champion your ideas, and give you room to do the best work of your career.

We're looking for a Producer who knows how to make the impossible happen.

You thrive in both environments. You know when to bring in the big guns and when to roll up your sleeves and figure it out yourself.

  • Make it happen. Take productions from concept to delivery. Find solutions, open doors, and keep pushing when things get difficult.

  • Run multiple productions. Manage several projects simultaneously, balancing budgets, schedules, crews, and competing priorities without losing track of the details.
